info.title: Quentn Universal API
info.description: Quentn integration for contacts, terms, custom fields, email, and campaign triggers using Quentn's public API.

requestIp.description: IPv4 address associated with the contact submission. Required when flood protection options are used.

duplicateCheckMethod.description: How Quentn should check for duplicates: auto, email, or none.

duplicateMergeMethod.description: How Quentn should merge duplicate contacts: update_add, update, or add.

floodLimit.description: Maximum number of contacts allowed from the same request IP within an hour.

spamProtection.description: Whether Quentn should check the request IP against a spam database.

maxLength.description: Optional max length for text fields. Allowed values include 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, and 255.
